text: APPROVE. Each extracted helper (`Blank`, `CommentEnd`, `ScanPrefix`, `LexRawLiteral`, `FindLiteralEnd`, `LexLiteral`) preserves the original logic, including the verbatim-string, escape, newline and unterminated-literal handling. `c == '/' && next is '/' or '*'` parses as intended, `Lex` and every helper now sit well under the complexity threshold, and I see no unused variables or other warning sources, though I did not run a build.
